correctness.rationale: The literal GP(10,2) adjacency has 20 vertices, 30 edges, degree three. Exhaustive independent BFS/Euler acyclicity analysis tested all 2^20=1,048,576 vertex masks and obtained exact k=0..14 forest coefficients [1,20,190,1140,4845,15492,38580,76260,120540,151920,150480,113400,60620,19600,2520], with zero k≥15 and sum 755,608. Exactly 2520 forests have order14; 1860 are trees, 660 have component sizes (1,13):280,(2,12):180,(4,10):120,(6,8):60,(7,7):20. All inclusion-maximal induced forests have order 13 (1120) or 14 (2520). Independent adjacency-preserving bijection enumeration found exactly 120 automorphisms. The 25 literal CSV representatives generate disjoint orbits covering all 2520 optimum masks, orbit sizes 120×18+60×5+40+20. These computations exhaust the FINITE graph only.
